triage.summary: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks Alex to automate their cake order form so orders are recorded in a Google Sheet and wants a price estimate.

task.title: Prepare a quote for cake order form automation
task.description: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks Alex to automate their cake order form so orders land in a Google Sheet and requests the cost.

reply.body:

Alex
